verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email service, so AI inbox triage is a fair question to ask of it. The pack documents only user-written Filters & Rules and spam filtering, which are adjacent manual or rule-based controls rather than AI triage. Community users say they miss Gmail-style automatic categorization and turn to third-party tools like Sanebox, so there is no evidence Fastmail itself auto-labels, categorizes or surfaces priority mail with AI, let alone in a steerable, auditable way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit
